name: Hunt Electronic Co., Ltd.
summary: Hunt Electronic Co., Ltd., a Taiwanese enterprise, specializes in the development, manufacturing, and global distribution of security and surveillance technologies. Their market reach extends across Taiwan, the broader Asian continent, the United States, and Europe. Their comprehensive product lineup includes a diverse range of network cameras, such as specialized explosion-proof IP, corrosion-resistant IP, and thermal IP models, as well as cameras designed for traffic surveillance, speed dome, fisheye, bullet, vandal-resistant dome, fixed dome, box, and cube configurations. They also provide advanced AI-driven thermal IP cameras. Beyond these, the company offers state-of-the-art 4G and 5G LTE cellular cameras, digital recording devices, and a suite of associated software products and applications. The firm was established in 1988 and operates from its main office situated in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
